title: Kamishiro Rui — Endless Imagination & Challenges〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: On behalf of Wonderlands×Showtime, thank you all for coming to see our show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's a wrap! Another show completely squared away without any trouble whatsoever!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, and I have all of you to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nonsense. Your safety measures are what make our shows possible, no?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Every time you come up with a new effect or some other amazing thing, you always make sure to tell us what's gonna happen!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hehe. Some other amazing thing?
You could do it a little more justice.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But that's the truth! It's always something super amazing♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like the one that went WHOOSH-BOING-THUNK! That was so much fun☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, from our second assignment as ambassadors. That was one of my best works yet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How did he get all that from “whoosh”?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Regardless, Rui's fantastical ideas are one of our troupe's greatest selling points!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I have to think that you're the only one out there who can come up with such zany ideas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you. I'm honored.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I suspect that there are plenty of others out there who are just as creative or interesting as me.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can name two at the very least.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I can guess who one is.
That director you really respect, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Correct.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <I'm constantly searching for new ideas and new challenges to take on. I refuse to be trapped inside a box...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <However, there is something that I always keep in mind.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <That is to “see beyond the fence”...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <It doesn't matter if you're rich or poor, clever or foolish, among the majority or minority...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <All people laugh, cry and feel anger in the same way...>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <That is what ties us all together after bearing witness to a truly marvelous spectacle.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <My goal is to keep making shows that do just that.>

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: <I believe that is the key to humanity becoming one... I believe that there's something unimaginable special awaiting us at the end of that path!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, Rui, does that mean the other person you were talking about is...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, the French novelist who's widely regarded as the father of science fiction...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His stories about discovering an underground world at the center of the Earth, exploring lost civilizations in a submarine and flying to the moon immediately come to mind...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The sheer realism grounded in actual science made many of his fans believe that they were true tales.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's still well known to this day since his works have been adapted into movies and even theme park attractions.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! He must've been an incredible person!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Incidentally, I was introduced to his works just as I was starting to see how fun shows are.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My scientific curiosity even compelled me to come up with my own hypotheses regarding what he wrote.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His story about a man being sent to the moon via a cannon was definitely my favorite growing up.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Is that why you're so obsessed with launching me into the air...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I've never thought of it that way...
I was under the impression that you were meant to soar through the sky...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm joking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm not lying about not thinking about it that way. At least, not consciously.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I read that book so many times that it began to fall apart, so a part of me must've been wanting to send you to the moon a la the protagonist.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He seems serious. Am I missing something...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, this is just who he is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup♪
Rui's Room

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm... I could've sworn that I left it around here somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aha, found it. “From the Earth to the Moon”...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. All that time I spent when I was little trying to figure out how to adapt this novel for the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And that one quote of his was something that I took to heart...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Anything one man can imagine, other men can make real.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: His stories were all about getting humanity to believe in what's possible by working together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is why I worked so hard to get my classmates to help me with my shows all those years ago...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: “Other men can make real...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I took that too seriously back then and flew too close to the sun. As a result, I ended up all alone.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Now I have...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? What's this...?
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was sure that I was being called over here. I guess that's not the case.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh? What's that over there...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A ball of light...?
Is this a prop for one of KAITO's shows?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I should get it back to him...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh?! What's happening...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Am I still in SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That ball must've been what caused this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I have no memory of this place...
But it seems vaguely familiar for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This place as a whole feels foreign, but I swear I've seen these objects and designs before somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, just try to relax and slowly figure out what's going on...
One, two! One, two!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm...? I hear people...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wait, that's...
